title: DSWD allows extension of 4Ps benefits beyond seven years

blocks.text: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) announced on Thursday that some qualified beneficiaries of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) may continue receiving assistance beyond the program’s maximum seven-year period.
